verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a Payment Links product that lets merchants "go to market in no time" and "requires no integration", which covers the no-code selling core of the story. However, the evidence never says links are created from the dashboard or how they are shared, and nothing addresses how quickly a new merchant can go live. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard-based link creation flow, documentation of sharing the link, evidence of immediate go-live and onboarding speed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create a shareable payment link from the dashboard with no code and start selling immediately

citations.quote: Payment links allow you to collect payments securely and go to market in no time... it requires no integration.
